proposal.reason: Main change is CE/ltOki DMA queue isolation and execution correctness, which is owned by copy-engine. Evidence: src/init.cc remaps ltOki QP queueId/ring reservation and CE stream ring hints (pcclCeHintMemcpyStream, useOkiRings), and src/ce_coll.cc switches batch-op stream-group behavior based on OKI-ring usage plus stream-hinting rules under capture; this directly changes CE/DMA stream/queue ownership and submission semantics. src/enqueue.cc and src/include/transport.h are supporting call-site/handshake wiring for the same CE/OKI feature, not an independent module policy change.
